platform: Windows x64, Abaqus 2025 HF1, Python 3.10.5 / NumPy 1.22.4
method: Five fresh processes per variant per fixture, sequential alternating order, complete saved baseline package versus current package. Same ODB bytes, instances, frames and PVD; bundled fixtures also export history. Imports/SDK startup and detailed instrumentation excluded from 40 primary timings. No cold-cache guarantee.
implementation: Build per-instance immutable NumPy LabelLookup objects once after geometry assembly, replace field-placement dictionaries, reuse across fields/frames. Dense offset table for span <= 4 * label count, otherwise sorted labels and rows with searchsorted. No source or writer changes.
validation: Final output sets match byte-for-byte for all four fixtures; input hashes unchanged; twelve VTU pairs checked with VTK. First-missing-label errors, sparse/dense bounds, ownership, instance namespaces and integration-point placement covered by tests.
